findings.message: Module `serv_rv32i_core` has registered read `o_mem_addr <= pc[addr];` which means `o_mem_addr` lags `addr` by 1 cycle. Consumer may incorrectly read it as combinational. Fix options: (a) document in module header as '1-cycle read latency' / 'registered read'; (b) add a companion `output o_mem_addr_valid` strobe; (c) if combinational is intended, use `assign o_mem_addr = pc[addr];` instead.
